_comment: Engine settings (roadmap P5 step 8, docs/API_CONTRACTS.md). Read and checked at start-up by ArabiziCore's EngineConfig; the engine code holds no copy of these numbers. `model` is an id from config/models.json (file, SHA-256 and prompt come from there). The fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B v3, trained with the real rows and the second friends-and-family batch, is switched on (ADR 0030, 29 Oct 2026; v2 before, ADR 0022; v1 before that, ADR 0005); the deadline grows with message length (1,500 ms up to 8 words, +120 ms per further word, at most 3,000 ms; ADR 0025); if its file is not in models/ when the keyboard is built, or does not match its SHA-256, the engine uses the rules.
